retainedImplementation: Uncached financial/point-summary consumers omit only unused workforce annotations; complete point/default readers keep them.
Shared monthly snapshots always force full workforce/ignored metadata, preserving keys, cross-consumer sharing and fresh independent Maps/Dates.
Response-only HTTP cache can send its immutable JSON without parse/stringify on hits; custom Express JSON options retain the standard object path.
Monthly period parents use deterministic createdAt/id order; no historical row or cost rule was removed.

dense-36-months.method: Five alternating pairs per mode, same local PostgreSQL fixture and financial-only consumer. Not HTTP/browser/production latency.

httpComparison.method: Local PostgreSQL + real HTTP/Express, 4 fresh APIs in baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline order. Same fixture/routes/admin and viewer. Only response cache enabled. 50/case/profile/round = 100/case/profile/version. Warmups excluded. At most one request at a time, keep-alive, no TLS/proxy/browser. Body equality, status, cache hits, stages and SQL calls recorded. Original 36-month synthetic fixture remains to make point-summary payload large. Not production latency.
httpComparison.parityMethod: Compare every HTTP field; only the root rates array of point_summary is sorted by collaborator ID for cross-version comparison. Candidate fixes previously unspecified roster order. Raw hashes are also recorded and each version must keep its own body stable across rounds.

earlierChecks.resolution: No timing acceptance. Large-object comparison now uses a boolean equality check without formatting the entire DTO as an assertion diff.

rejectedExperiment.reason: Final comparison showed a warm-path regression; changes and dedicated tests were removed instead of treating exploratory gains as acceptance.

comparison.method: Five alternating pairs per mode, same local synthetic PostgreSQL and 36-month/21-collaborator fixture, full results compared. Warm SQL pages. No HTTP/TLS/browser or production measurements. Timing excludes import/process startup/JSON output. All new caches off.
comparison.parityMethod: Compare every field after sorting only the root rates array and byCollaboratorId map entries by collaborator ID. Candidate now guarantees stable period creation/id order, unlike the unordered baseline. No date trails, allocations, months, values or fields are sorted away or omitted.

limitations: Calculation cases have only five alternating pairs per mode; medians/CPU are component observations, not p95/browser/production acceptance.
Dense calculation showed no consistent gain, including about 2 percent higher cold median; do not generalize sparse-history savings to every dataset.
Calculation parity retains all financial/audit/date/month fields, omitting only the three workforce annotation fields unused by that consumer after timing.
Previously unspecified roster order is now deterministic. Cross-version comparisons sort only root roster/map entries by collaborator ID; no financial precision or other field/order is discarded.
HTTP cohort consists of unexpired response-cache hits, local keep-alive, concurrency one, no TLS/proxy/browser. Both modes made 3800 measured pool calls.
Monthly cache enabled still requests a complete shared graph; the annotation optimization applies to the uncached path.
No production deployment, flags, jobs, backup schedule or retention were changed in this continuation. Staging/production acceptance remains separate.
